purpose: Maps every clause anchor in the module to the capture file and record it was derived from. The module is the authority; this file records HOW each clause was derived so a reviewer can audit it. Nothing here is normative.
domain_note: Colour is the largest captured domain (7478 registry rows) and has almost no menu surface (5 menu rows). The model in this module was therefore built from parsed value types, enumerations, preset payloads and shader source rather than transcribed from a command tree.

evidence_kind_legend.parsed: read directly out of a parsed capture record
evidence_kind_legend.derived: computed or inferred from parsed capture records; the inference is stated in the clause
evidence_kind_legend.contract: an authoring-contract or operator rule, not an application observation
evidence_kind_legend.spec_text: the superseded Master Spec text itself
evidence_kind_legend.defect_notice: a recorded defect in the capture, cited so the clause does not rely on it
evidence_kind_legend.recovery_limit: a capture that did not recover the value; the clause records the limit and does not fabricate

derivation_legend.derived: clause states a consequence of what the capture states
derivation_legend.studio_normative_choice: clause fixes a value no capture declared; the clause says so inline

derivation_legend.restatement_hardened: clause restates a retained anchor and adds binding detail
derivation_legend.governance: clause is authority or scope bookkeeping, not behaviour
derivation_legend.parsed+normative_choice: clause mixes parsed values with a stated Studio choice

derivation_legend.parsed+contradiction_of_record: clause is parsed and simultaneously records a trap the capture exposed
